title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2 WITH 3 BALCONIES + PARKING, AT DRY LAKE!
description_en: A 2+1+2 apartment invested down to the last detail is offered for sale, located in one of the quietest and favorite areas of Tirana - Dry Lake, very close to the Radisson Hotel. The complex is characterized by high construction quality and good management.
